WITH per AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('PY',DATE '2024-11-25',DATE '2024-12-22'),('LY',DATE '2025-11-24',DATE '2025-12-21')) t(yr,s,e)),
rpt AS (SELECT per.yr, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) gross_rpt, sum(r.returns_net) ret_rpt, sum(r.net_sales) net_rpt, count(distinct r.store_id) stores, max(r.store_id) maxstore FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN per ON r.business_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1),
fs AS (SELECT per.yr,
  sum(case when st.store_id<900 then f.net_amount end) st_all,
  sum(case when st.store_id<900 and not f.staff_purchase_flag then f.net_amount end) st_nostaff,
  sum(case when st.store_id=900 then f.net_amount end) web,
  sum(case when st.store_id=999 then f.net_amount end) train
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1),
fr AS (SELECT per.yr,
  sum(case when st.store_id<900 then r.refund_net end) ret_st, sum(case when st.store_id=900 then r.refund_net end) ret_web, sum(case when st.store_id=999 then r.refund_net end) ret_train
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM rpt JOIN fs USING (yr) JOIN fr USING (yr)

WITH fs AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, st.store_id sid, sum(f.net_amount) fact_net, sum(case when f.staff_purchase_flag then f.net_amount else 0 end) staff_net, count(distinct f.receipt_id) rc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id sid, net_sales_before_returns g, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21')
SELECT coalesce(fs.d,r.d) d, coalesce(fs.sid,r.sid) sid, fs.fact_net, fs.staff_net, r.g, round(coalesce(fs.fact_net,0)-coalesce(r.g,0),2) diff, fs.rc, r.receipts
FROM fs FULL JOIN r ON fs.d=r.d AND fs.sid=r.sid
WHERE abs(coalesce(fs.fact_net,0)-coalesce(r.g,0))>0.005 ORDER BY abs(diff) DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'LY' END yr, coalesce(w.status,'<no order row>') status, count(*) lines, count(distinct f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(case when f.sale_date<>CAST(w.order_ts_utc AS DATE) then 1 else 0 end) date_ne_order_utc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE st.store_id=900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-25' AND DATE '2024-12-22' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'LY' END yr, st.store_id>=900 pseudo, count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) dist_id, count(distinct r.sales_line_id) dist_sl, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(case when s.sales_line_id is null then 1 else 0 end) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-25' AND DATE '2024-12-22' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH per AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('FY2024/25',DATE '2024-11-25',DATE '2024-12-22'),('FY2025/26',DATE '2025-11-24',DATE '2025-12-21')) t(fy,s,e)),
cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS cur_category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
sales AS (
  SELECT per.fy, c.cur_category AS category, p.category AS recorded_category, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku
  WHERE st.store_id<>999 AND c.cur_category IN ('Garden','Electrical')),
rets AS (
  SELECT per.fy, c.cur_category AS category, p.category AS recorded_category, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku
  WHERE st.store_id<>999 AND c.cur_category IN ('Garden','Electrical')),
u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)
SELECT category,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2024/25' THEN amt END),2) AS ny_py_restated,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2025/26' THEN amt END),2) AS ny_ly_restated,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2025/26' THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2024/25' THEN amt END)-1),2) AS growth_restated,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2024/25' AND recorded_category=category THEN amt END),2) AS py_asrecorded,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2025/26' AND recorded_category=category THEN amt END),2) AS ly_asrecorded
FROM u GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
